item.title: Flanders 0.17.0
item.description:
### Added
- **Sparkle auto-updates.** Flanders now checks for updates daily and via
  Flanders ▸ Check for Updates…. Updates are EdDSA-signed and served from the
  public `ijasonwhite/flanders-updates` repo (appcast + notarized zips only —
  no source). `scripts/release.sh` signs, uploads and publishes the appcast
  entry automatically after notarization.
- **Licensing scaffold (dark).** Offline-verifiable Ed25519 licence keys
  (Stripe Checkout webhook → signed key by email → paste into Settings ▸
  Licence, verified with CryptoKit, stored in the Keychain). Nothing is gated
  yet — plumbing only, ahead of a pricing decision. Server side is vanilla
  PHP in `licensing/`.
